newsitem.title: USA: Medical Cell Recovery System gets FDA ok.
newsitem.headline: Medical Cell Recovery System gets FDA ok.

text.p: Medical Device Technologies Inc said Tuesday the Food and Drug Administration has cleared its Cell Recovery System, allowing it to begin its cost-saving manufacturing process and its comparative clinical study.
The study will compare the Cell Recovery System and conventional biopsy methods used in diagnosing bladder cancer, the company said.

"With this clearance, we believe that Medical Device Technologies can make the Cell Recovery System more economical to produce, which will help to properly position the product for the cost-conscious managed care market," the company said in a release.
